us.intro: To keep the marketplace safe, you must verify your identity before listing items. We use Stripe to verify your ID and a selfie — the whole flow happens on Stripe and we never store your ID images.
us.step1: Have a valid government-issued ID ready (driver's license, passport, or ID card).
us.step2: Capture the front and back of your ID on Stripe's secure page.
us.step3: Take a live selfie to match against your ID photo.
us.privacy: Your ID and selfie are encrypted and handled by Stripe for verification only. We do not retain the original images.
